generic.Defined scope/population: All intake-stage cases ready to move to In Resolution in Salesforce FSC for the shift
generic.In-scope period: Cases advanced during the current operating day and shift window
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Case status, resolution queue, owner and intake notes present before the stage change
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of cases leaving Intake equals count arriving in the resolution queue
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Stage-change audit entry retained with actor and timestamp on the case record
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cases that fail to advance are logged with the blocking reason and reworked
generic.Test population: Sample of cases showing an Intake to In Resolution transition in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100 percent of advanced cases carry an owner and a started resolution SLA clock
generic.Exception handling path: Unassigned or SLA-less cases return to the supervisor queue for manual assignment
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Case is In Resolution, owned, SLA running and intake evidence attached
generic.Evidence location: Salesforce FSC case history and the workflow/case management tool routing log

steps.title: Open the intake case record in Salesforce FSC
sop: Open the case from your Salesforce FSC queue using the case reference given at intake
Read the intake notes and confirm the reason code still matches the customer request
Confirm the case is not already sitting at a later stage
Done when the correct intake-stage case is open on screen
verify: Check the case number on screen matches the one you were routed
Pass when the open case shows status Intake and a populated reason code

steps.title: Attach intake notes and customer documents to the case in Salesforce FSC
sop: Upload every document or image the customer supplied during intake to the case files section
Paste the interaction transcript reference into the case notes
Name each attachment so the resolution handler can identify it without opening it
Done when all intake evidence is attached to the case
verify: Reopen the case files list and count the attachments against what the customer sent
Pass when no intake document remains outside the case record

steps.title: Set the case status to In Resolution in Salesforce FSC
sop: Change the status picklist from Intake to In Resolution
Select the resolution sub-stage that matches the work still outstanding
Save the record and wait for the confirmation banner
Done when the case header displays In Resolution
verify: Refresh the case and read the status field again
Pass when the saved status is In Resolution and the change appears in case history

steps.title: Route the case to the resolution queue in the workflow/case management tool
sop: Select the resolution queue that owns the case reason code from the routing list
Submit the routing action rather than leaving the case in your personal queue
Add a routing note stating what the resolution handler must do next
Done when the case leaves your personal work list
verify: Search the resolution queue for the case number
Pass when the case is visible in the target resolution queue

steps.title: Confirm the case shows an assigned owner in the workflow/case management tool
sop: Open the routed case and read the assigned owner field
Escalate to the supervisor if the case sits unowned past the queue timeout
Record the owner name in the case notes for the customer callback
Done when a named owner is shown against the case
verify: Check the owner field is a named person and not a placeholder queue
Pass when an individual owner is recorded on the case

steps.title: Verify the resolution SLA clock started on the case in Salesforce FSC
sop: Open the milestone or entitlement panel on the case
Confirm the resolution milestone shows a start time matching the stage change
Raise a defect note where the milestone did not start
Done when the resolution milestone is running
verify: Compare the milestone start time against the stage-change timestamp in case history
Pass when the two timestamps match to the minute

steps.title: Peer-check the advanced case in Salesforce FSC before handover
sop: Review the case status, owner, attachments and SLA start on a sample of advanced cases
Return any case missing intake evidence to the advancing agent
Record the check outcome in the case or the shift log
Done when the sample has been reviewed and outcomes recorded
verify: Count returned cases against cases checked for the shift
Pass when every checked case carries owner, SLA start and intake evidence

generic.Defined scope/population: Routine intents eligible for IVR or digital deflection in Genesys Cloud and the self-service portal
generic.In-scope period: Contacts handled during the current reporting month with deflection enabled
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Deflection outcome code, intent and delivery channel populated on the interaction
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Deflection link sends reconcile to self-service sessions started in the portal
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: IVR menu version and deflection link send records retained with dispatch timestamps
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Deflected customers who re-enter the voice queue are logged and the intent reviewed
generic.Test population: All contacts matching a deflection-eligible intent in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every deflected contact carries an outcome code and zero-out to agent works from each prompt
generic.Exception handling path: Failed deflection returns the customer to the agent queue without repeating authentication
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Top five routine intents offered, link delivered and outcome code recorded
generic.Evidence location: Genesys Cloud interaction records and the Customer Self-Service Portal session log

steps.title: Review the IVR menu configuration in Genesys Cloud against the top five routine intents
sop: List the top five routine intents by volume covering balance, ID card, address, payment and claim status
Open the IVR flow in Genesys Cloud and confirm each intent has a reachable menu option
Note any intent with no self-service path for the enhancement backlog
Done when every top intent is mapped to a live menu option or logged as a gap
verify: Call the IVR and walk each of the five options end to end
Pass when all five routine intents are selectable from the published menu

steps.title: Confirm the zero-out to agent path works from every deflection prompt in Genesys Cloud
sop: Test the agent opt-out key at each deflection prompt in the IVR flow
Confirm the caller lands in the correct skill queue and not a dead end
Log any prompt where opt-out fails as a priority defect
Done when every deflection prompt offers a working route to an agent
verify: Repeat the opt-out test on the two highest-volume prompts
Pass when each test reaches a live agent queue

steps.title: Send the SMS or chat deep link to the self-service task from Genesys Cloud
sop: Select the deep link that matches the customer intent rather than the portal home page
Send to the mobile number or chat session already on the interaction
Tell the customer what they will see when they open the link
Done when the link is dispatched to the customer
verify: Check the delivery status on the interaction record
Pass when the send shows delivered and not failed or bounced

steps.title: Confirm the self-service session started in the Customer Self-Service Portal
sop: Check the portal session log for a session opened from the deflection link
Stay available to the customer until the session opens where the channel allows
Return the contact to assisted handling if no session starts
Done when a session start is confirmed or assisted handling resumes
verify: Match the session identifier to the interaction identifier
Pass when the session log shows a start against the deflected interaction

steps.title: Record the deflection outcome code on the interaction record in Genesys Cloud
sop: Select the outcome code that reflects what actually happened rather than the default
Distinguish deflected and completed from deflected and abandoned
Save the wrap-up before going available for the next contact
Done when the outcome code is saved on the interaction
verify: Re-open the interaction and read the outcome code
Pass when a non-default deflection outcome code is present

steps.title: Check deflected customers did not re-enter the voice queue within 24 hours
sop: Extract deflected interactions from Genesys Cloud for the previous day
Match the customer identifier against voice contacts received in the following 24 hours
List the intents with the highest repeat-contact rate
Done when the repeat-contact list for the day is produced
verify: Recalculate the repeat rate for the highest-volume intent
Pass when the repeat rate is calculated and recorded for every deflected intent

steps.title: Review deflection performance and approve continued deflection with the operations manager
sop: Review outcome codes, session starts and repeat contacts for the period
Withdraw deflection for any intent where repeat contacts exceed the agreed limit
Record the decision and the effective date in the channel review log
Done when the deflection decision for each intent is recorded
verify: Check every in-scope intent has a recorded keep or withdraw decision
Pass when no eligible intent is left without a documented decision

generic.Defined scope/population: Every inbound interaction in Genesys Cloud where account, policy or claim data may be disclosed
generic.In-scope period: All authenticated contacts handled during the current operating day
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Authentication flag, method used and outcome recorded on the Genesys interaction
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of disclosing interactions equals count carrying an authentication outcome
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Authentication event retained with method, timestamp and agent identifier
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Failed authentications logged with the alternative channel offered to the caller
generic.Test population: Sample of interactions where policy, billing or claim detail was discussed
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Zero interactions disclosing account data without a Passed authentication flag
generic.Exception handling path: Failed authentication routes the customer to the written channel and a supervisor note
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Two knowledge-based answers correct or a one-time passcode confirmed before disclosure
generic.Evidence location: Genesys Cloud interaction authentication events and the Salesforce FSC case notes

steps.title: Open the customer record in Salesforce FSC before asking any question
sop: Confirm the screen-pop opened the record the caller claims to be
Locate the stored date of birth, policy number and contact number for comparison
Do not read any stored value aloud to the caller
Done when the reference record is open and the comparison values are visible
verify: Check the record open matches the policy or account the caller quoted
Pass when the correct customer record is on screen before questioning starts

steps.title: Ask two knowledge-based questions drawn from the Salesforce FSC policy record
sop: Ask for date of birth and policy number and let the caller state them unprompted
Compare each answer against the stored value without hinting at the correct response
Move to the one-time passcode route where an answer is close but not exact
Done when both answers have been compared against the record
verify: Confirm both answers matched the stored values exactly
Pass when two independent identifiers were confirmed correct

steps.title: Send the one-time passcode to the number on file from Genesys Cloud
sop: Send the passcode only to the contact number already stored on the customer record
Never send the passcode to a number the caller has supplied on this call
Ask the caller to read the passcode back and compare it to the issued code
Done when the passcode has been issued and read back
verify: Check the passcode destination against the stored contact number
Pass when the passcode went to the stored number and was correctly returned

steps.title: Set the authentication flag to Passed or Failed on the Genesys Cloud interaction
sop: Select the authentication result that reflects the actual outcome of the checks
Record which method was used for the successful or failed attempt
Save the flag before continuing the conversation
Done when the authentication flag is saved on the interaction
verify: Re-open the interaction and read the authentication field
Pass when the flag is set and matches what happened on the call

steps.title: Withhold all account detail until the Salesforce FSC authentication flag reads Passed
sop: Do not confirm or deny policy, billing or claim detail while the flag is not Passed
Answer only general product questions that require no account access
Tell the caller plainly which checks remain outstanding
Done when no account detail has been disclosed ahead of a Passed flag
verify: Review the interaction notes for any account detail stated before the flag was set
Pass when the first account disclosure follows the Passed flag timestamp

steps.title: Log the failed authentication and offer the written channel in Salesforce FSC
sop: Write a case note recording which checks failed without recording the answers given
Offer the written or branch channel and explain the identification the customer must supply
Escalate to the senior agent where the caller becomes abusive or persistent
Done when the failure note is saved and the alternative channel is offered
verify: Check every failed interaction carries a note and an offered alternative
Pass when no failed authentication is closed without a note and an alternative

steps.title: Review sampled authentication events in Genesys Cloud for compliance
sop: Pull a sample of interactions that disclosed account data during the period
Confirm each carries an authentication outcome and that disclosure followed it
Raise an auto-fail against the quality score where disclosure preceded authentication
Done when the sample review is complete and findings recorded
verify: Recount failures found against interactions reviewed
Pass when every sampled disclosing interaction shows a prior Passed flag

generic.Defined scope/population: Every handled contact in Genesys Cloud requiring a reason and sub-reason classification
generic.In-scope period: Contacts classified during the current operating day and wrap-up window
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Reason and sub-reason selected from the controlled picklist on the interaction
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Handled contact count equals the count of interactions carrying a reason code
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Reason code and any wrap-up correction retained with the interaction timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Contacts closed with a generic reason are logged and reclassified by the supervisor
generic.Test population: Sample of closed interactions across billing, policy, claims, complaint and general
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Both reason and sub-reason populated on 100 percent of closed interactions
generic.Exception handling path: Unclear reasons are set to the closest category and referred to the supervisor for review
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Reason matches the wrap-up outcome and dissatisfaction is tagged as a complaint
generic.Evidence location: Genesys Cloud wrap-up codes and the linked Salesforce FSC case reason fields

steps.title: Capture the customer stated reason in the Salesforce FSC case description
sop: Ask an open question and write the reason in the customer own words
Avoid substituting an internal process name for what the customer asked
Confirm your summary back to the customer before classifying
Done when the stated reason is written on the case
verify: Read the description back and check it names a customer need rather than a system action
Pass when the case description states the customer request in plain language

steps.title: Select the contact reason from the Genesys Cloud controlled picklist
sop: Choose billing, policy, claims inquiry, complaint or general from the picklist
Do not leave the default value in place at wrap-up
Ask the senior agent where two categories appear equally valid
Done when a parent reason is selected
verify: Check the selected value is not the picklist default
Pass when a deliberate parent reason is recorded

steps.title: Set the sub-reason to the lowest available level in Genesys Cloud
sop: Expand the sub-reason list and select the most specific value available
Do not stop at the parent when a child value exists
Report missing sub-reason values to the supervisor for picklist maintenance
Done when the lowest applicable sub-reason is selected
verify: Confirm no further child value exists beneath the selected sub-reason
Pass when the selection sits at the lowest available level

steps.title: Tag the contact as a complaint in Salesforce FSC where dissatisfaction is expressed
sop: Apply the complaint tag whenever the customer expresses dissatisfaction even if resolved on the call
Record the specific dissatisfaction expressed rather than a generic label
Do not withhold the tag because the issue was fixed during the contact
Done when dissatisfaction is either tagged or explicitly absent
verify: Compare the case notes against the complaint tag on sampled interactions
Pass when every note describing dissatisfaction carries the complaint tag

steps.title: Reconcile the reason code against the outcome at wrap-up in Genesys Cloud
sop: Compare the reason selected at the start against what the contact actually turned out to be
Correct the reason code where the conversation moved to a different topic
Record the reason for any correction in the case notes
Done when the saved reason matches the actual outcome
verify: Read the wrap-up note against the final reason code
Pass when the reason code and the documented outcome describe the same issue

steps.title: Save the classification before wrap-up expires in Genesys Cloud
sop: Save the wrap-up while still in after-call work rather than going available first
Confirm the save banner appears before releasing the interaction
Re-key the wrap-up immediately if the save fails
Done when the classification is saved against the interaction
verify: Search the interaction and read the stored reason and sub-reason
Pass when both values persist after the interaction closes

steps.title: Review classification accuracy across the team in Genesys Cloud
sop: Pull the reason-code distribution for the period and look for over-use of general
Sample interactions in the general category and check whether a better code existed
Feed misclassification findings into the coaching themes list
Done when the distribution review is complete and findings logged
verify: Recheck the sampled misclassifications after correction
Pass when every sampled interaction carries a reason matching its content

generic.Defined scope/population: Work items awaiting distribution in Genesys Cloud and the workflow/case management tool
generic.In-scope period: Items distributed during the current shift and intraday routing window
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Assigned owner, assignment timestamp, routing skill and intake context on every item
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Items leaving the routing pool equal items appearing in agent queues
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Routing and assignment events retained with timestamps in the case tool
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Items unopened past the queue timeout are logged and reassigned
generic.Test population: All work items distributed to representatives during the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Every distributed item carries an assigned owner and an assignment timestamp
generic.Exception handling path: Skill-match failures fall back to the supervisor queue for manual assignment
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Item is in the assigned agent queue with intake notes and attachments intact
generic.Evidence location: Genesys Cloud routing log and the workflow/case management tool assignment history

steps.title: Review the pending work item pool in the workflow/case management tool
sop: Sort the pending pool by age and by priority flag
Identify items breaching or approaching the distribution standard
Note any item missing the intake context needed to assign it
Done when the pending pool is triaged for the interval
verify: Recount the pending pool after triage
Pass when every pending item is either assigned or flagged with a blocker

steps.title: Match the routing skill to the contact reason code in Genesys Cloud
sop: Open the routing matrix and find the skill that owns the item reason code
Do not fall back to the default queue where a specific skill exists
Record the chosen skill on the work item
Done when a reason-matched skill is selected for the item
verify: Compare the applied skill against the routing matrix entry for the reason code
Pass when the skill matches the matrix and is not the default queue

steps.title: Verify intake notes and attachments carried over in the workflow/case management tool
sop: Open the item and confirm the intake notes are readable and complete
Confirm every intake attachment is present and opens without error
Return the item to intake where context is missing rather than guessing
Done when the item carries the full intake context
verify: Compare the attachment count against the intake record
Pass when notes and all attachments are present on the distributed item

steps.title: Release the work item to the assigned agent queue in Genesys Cloud
sop: Submit the routing action to the selected skill queue
Confirm agent availability in that skill before releasing a time-critical item
Add a handling note where the item needs a specific approach
Done when the item has been released to the target queue
verify: Search the target queue for the item reference
Pass when the item is visible in the assigned agent queue

steps.title: Confirm the assignment timestamp and owner recorded on the item
sop: Extract distributed items for the interval from the case tool
Confirm each row carries a named owner and an assignment timestamp
List any item lacking either value for supervisor action
Done when the assignment completeness list is produced
verify: Recount rows missing owner or timestamp after correction
Pass when no distributed item lacks an owner or an assignment time

steps.title: Reassign items unopened past the queue timeout in the workflow/case management tool
sop: Filter for items assigned but not opened beyond the queue timeout
Reassign to an available agent in the same skill
Record the reassignment reason against the item
Done when no item remains unopened past the timeout
verify: Rerun the unopened filter after reassignment
Pass when the unopened list returns no items past the timeout

steps.title: Log distribution exceptions and skill-match failures for the interval
sop: Record every default-queue fallback and its reason in the intraday log
Trend recurring skill gaps for the routing matrix review
Share the exception list with the supervisor at the interval handover
Done when the interval exception log is complete
verify: Compare logged exceptions against default-queue routings in Genesys Cloud
Pass when every default-queue routing has a logged reason

generic.Defined scope/population: Contacts meeting the vulnerable-customer or high-risk trigger definitions in Genesys Cloud
generic.In-scope period: Escalations raised during the current operating day
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Vulnerability flag, escalation trigger, raise time and acknowledgement time recorded
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Escalations raised equal escalations acknowledged by the specialist queue
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Vulnerability indicator dated on the customer record and retained on the case
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Escalations not acknowledged within 15 minutes are logged and chased
generic.Test population: All cases carrying a vulnerable-customer or high-risk escalation trigger
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: 100 percent of escalations show a trigger, a raise time and an acknowledgement
generic.Exception handling path: Unaccepted escalations go to the duty supervisor for direct allocation
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Specialist accepted the case and the vulnerability flag persists on the customer record
generic.Evidence location: Salesforce FSC customer record flags and the Genesys Cloud transfer history

steps.title: Identify the escalation trigger during the Genesys Cloud interaction
sop: Listen for bereavement, financial hardship, capacity or safeguarding indicators
Ask a gentle confirming question rather than assuming the circumstance
Stop routine processing once a trigger is identified
Done when the trigger category is identified for the contact
verify: Check the identified trigger appears in the published trigger list
Pass when the trigger maps to a defined vulnerability category

steps.title: Apply the vulnerable-customer flag on the Salesforce FSC customer record
sop: Set the vulnerability indicator at customer level so future contacts inherit the handling
Record the date the flag was applied and the handling adjustment needed
Avoid recording sensitive detail beyond what the handling requires
Done when the flag is saved on the customer record
verify: Reopen the customer record and read the vulnerability indicator
Pass when the flag is present and dated on the customer record

steps.title: Record the escalation trigger on the case in Salesforce FSC
sop: Select the trigger category from the escalation picklist on the case
Write what the customer said that led to the escalation
Note any immediate accommodation already agreed with the customer
Done when the trigger and context are saved on the case
verify: Check the case shows a trigger category and supporting note
Pass when both the category and the context are recorded

steps.title: Warm-transfer the contact to the specialist queue in Genesys Cloud
sop: Use the specialist skill queue rather than a cold transfer or voicemail
Brief the receiving handler while the customer is on hold
Introduce the customer to the specialist before leaving the call
Done when the specialist is on the line with the customer
verify: Read the transfer type recorded on the interaction
Pass when the transfer is recorded as warm and connected

steps.title: Notify the duty supervisor through the escalation channel within 15 minutes
sop: Post the escalation to the duty supervisor channel with the case reference
State the trigger, the customer risk and any action already taken
Chase directly if there is no response inside the notification window
Done when the duty supervisor has been notified
verify: Compare the notification time against the escalation raise time on the case
Pass when notification occurred within 15 minutes of the raise

steps.title: Confirm the specialist accepted the case in Salesforce FSC before closing the contact
sop: Accept the escalated case and take ownership in the case record
Confirm you can see the trigger and the intake context
Tell the transferring agent that ownership is accepted
Done when case ownership sits with the specialist
verify: Check the case owner field against the specialist name
Pass when the specialist is recorded as case owner with an acceptance time

steps.title: Review escalation acknowledgement times in Salesforce FSC for the day
sop: Extract escalations raised for the day with raise and acknowledgement times
Chase any escalation without an acknowledgement
Record breaches and their cause in the escalation log
Done when every escalation for the day has an acknowledgement or a chase record
verify: Recount escalations lacking acknowledgement after the chase
Pass when no escalation for the day is left unacknowledged

generic.Defined scope/population: Contacts meeting priority criteria for vulnerability, regulatory complaint or high account value
generic.In-scope period: Contacts flagged during the current operating day
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Priority indicator, qualifying reason and expedited queue set on the case
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Cases flagged High equal cases present in the expedited routing queue
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Priority flag and reason retained with the setting agent and timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Cases flagged High without a qualifying reason are logged and corrected

generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Priority reason populated on 100 percent of cases flagged High

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Case is High priority, correctly tagged, in the expedited queue with the expedited SLA running
generic.Evidence location: Salesforce FSC case priority fields and the Genesys Cloud routing history

steps.title: Assess the contact against the priority criteria in Salesforce FSC
sop: Check the customer record for an existing vulnerability or high-value indicator
Listen for regulatory complaint language that triggers expedited handling
Do not flag High simply because the customer is insistent
Done when the priority decision is made against the published criteria
verify: Match the decision against the published priority criteria list
Pass when the decision maps to a named qualifying criterion

steps.title: Set the priority indicator to High on the case in Salesforce FSC
sop: Set the priority field to High and select the qualifying reason from the picklist
Write a short note naming the evidence for the priority decision
Save the record and confirm the priority banner appears
Done when the case shows High priority with a reason
verify: Reopen the case and read the priority and reason fields
Pass when both priority and reason are populated

steps.title: Apply the account-value, vulnerable-customer or regulatory tag in Salesforce FSC
sop: Apply every tag that genuinely applies rather than only the first one
Set the vulnerability tag at customer level so it persists beyond this case
Remove any tag applied in error and note the correction
Done when the applicable tags are saved
verify: Compare tags applied against the qualifying reason recorded
Pass when the tags and the qualifying reason are consistent

steps.title: Move the interaction into the expedited routing queue in Genesys Cloud
sop: Route the interaction to the expedited queue rather than leaving it in general
Confirm the expedited queue has available capacity before releasing
Tell the customer that their contact is being prioritised
Done when the interaction is in the expedited queue
verify: Search the expedited queue for the interaction reference
Pass when the interaction appears in the expedited queue

steps.title: Confirm the expedited SLA timer applied to the case in Salesforce FSC
sop: Open the milestone panel and read the applied service level
Confirm the expedited target rather than the standard target is running
Raise a defect note where the standard target persists
Done when the expedited milestone is running on the case
verify: Compare the applied target against the published expedited standard
Pass when the expedited target is the one running

steps.title: Track expedited case ageing in Genesys Cloud through the shift
sop: Report expedited queue depth and oldest waiting item each interval
Alert the supervisor when an expedited item approaches its target
Record intraday actions taken to protect the expedited queue
Done when the expedited queue is reported for every interval
verify: Check an interval report exists for each interval of the shift
Pass when no interval is missing an expedited queue reading

steps.title: Review High priority cases for qualifying reasons in Salesforce FSC
sop: Extract cases flagged High for the day with their qualifying reasons
Downgrade cases that do not meet a published criterion and record why
Coach agents who repeatedly flag without qualification
Done when every High case has a validated reason or has been downgraded
verify: Recount High cases lacking a qualifying reason after review
Pass when no High case remains without a qualifying reason

generic.Defined scope/population: Every handled contact requiring an interaction record in Salesforce FSC
generic.In-scope period: Contacts logged during the current operating day and wrap-up window

generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Genesys Cloud handled contacts equal Salesforce FSC interaction records for the day

steps.title: Confirm the Genesys Cloud screen-pop opened the correct Salesforce FSC customer
sop: Compare the popped record against the caller identifiers confirmed at authentication
Search manually and open the correct record where the pop is wrong
Close the incorrectly popped record so it is not updated by mistake
Done when the correct customer record is open and linked
verify: Check the linked customer name against the authenticated caller
Pass when the linked record matches the authenticated caller

steps.title: Create the interaction record in Salesforce FSC with channel and start time
sop: Create the interaction and set channel to phone, email, chat, portal or letter
Confirm the start timestamp carried across from Genesys Cloud
Do not create a duplicate where the integration already opened one
Done when a single interaction record exists for the contact
verify: Search the customer for interactions created in the last hour
Pass when exactly one interaction exists for this contact

steps.title: Populate the reason code and customer identifier on the interaction
sop: Select the reason code that matches the classification made in Genesys Cloud
Confirm the policy or account identifier is attached to the interaction
Correct any inherited reason code that no longer fits the conversation
Done when reason code and identifier are populated
verify: Compare the Salesforce reason code against the Genesys wrap-up code
Pass when the two reason codes agree

steps.title: Paste the Genesys Cloud transcript reference into the interaction
sop: Copy the call or chat reference identifier from the Genesys interaction
Paste it into the reference field on the Salesforce interaction
Do not paste transcript content containing card or bank detail
Done when the transcript reference is stored on the interaction
verify: Use the stored reference to retrieve the recording in Genesys Cloud
Pass when the reference retrieves the matching recording

steps.title: Save the interaction in Salesforce FSC before wrap-up time expires
sop: Save while still in after-call work rather than going available first
Wait for the save confirmation before closing the tab
Re-key immediately where the save fails so nothing is lost
Done when the interaction is saved and visible on the customer timeline
verify: Refresh the customer timeline and locate the interaction
Pass when the saved interaction appears on the customer record

steps.title: Check for unlinked interaction records at the end of the shift
sop: Filter your interactions for the shift where the customer link is empty
Use the transcript reference to identify the correct customer
Link each orphan record or escalate where identification is impossible
Done when no orphan interactions remain from your shift
verify: Rerun the unlinked filter after correction
Pass when the unlinked filter returns no rows for your shift

steps.title: Reconcile Genesys Cloud handled contacts against Salesforce FSC interactions
sop: Extract handled contact counts from Genesys Cloud for the day
Compare against interaction records created in Salesforce FSC for the same day
Investigate and log any variance above the agreed tolerance
Done when the daily reconciliation is complete and documented
verify: Recompute the variance after any corrections are applied

generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Interval offered volumes in Genesys Cloud reconcile to the Power BI intraday report

generic.Defined scope/population: Candidate service improvement initiatives in the backlog awaiting prioritisation

generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Scoring rationale and ranked list retained with the cycle date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Initiatives that cannot be scored are logged and held for more data
generic.Test population: All candidate initiatives in the backlog for the cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Initiatives scored on impact, volume and cost with a published ranking
generic.Exception handling path: Initiatives with unresolved dependencies are ranked but marked as blocked
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Ranked list published with scoring rationale visible to owners
generic.Evidence location: BI/reporting platform scoring data and the workflow/case management tool backlog

steps.title: Assemble the candidate initiatives from the backlog
sop: List every candidate initiative in the improvement backlog
Remove duplicates and merge overlapping items
Confirm each has a stated problem and proposed change
Done when the candidate list is assembled
verify: Count candidates against backlog entries
Pass when every backlog entry is represented

steps.title: Score each initiative on customer impact
sop: Score impact using the published criteria rather than opinion
Use survey and complaint evidence to support the score
Record the evidence behind each score
Done when impact scores are assigned
verify: Check each impact score cites supporting evidence
Pass when every score is evidenced

steps.title: Quantify contact volume and cost-to-serve in the BI platform
sop: Measure the contact volume the problem generates
Convert the volume into cost using the standard handling rate
State the assumptions used
Done when volume and cost are quantified
verify: Recompute the cost for the largest initiative

steps.title: Estimate effort and identify dependencies
sop: Estimate the effort in the units the delivery teams use
Identify system, training and third-party dependencies
Mark initiatives blocked by an unresolved dependency
Done when effort and dependencies are recorded
verify: Check each initiative carries an effort estimate and dependency note

steps.title: Rank the backlog using the combined scores
sop: Apply the agreed weighting across impact, volume, cost and effort
Produce the ranked list without manual reordering
Note any override and its justification
Done when the ranked list is produced
verify: Recompute the rank of the top three initiatives

steps.title: Confirm the top items with operations management
sop: Review the top items against capacity for the coming cycle
Confirm or adjust the order with a recorded reason
Assign owners to the items that will be started
Done when the top items are confirmed
verify: Check each confirmed item has an owner
Pass when every started item carries an owner

steps.title: Publish the ranked list with the scoring rationale
sop: Publish the ranking with the scores and rationale visible
Circulate to initiative owners and stakeholders
Record the date the ranking takes effect
Done when the ranked list is published
verify: Open the published list and read the rationale for a sampled item

generic.Defined scope/population: Service improvement initiatives with committed benefits and remaining gap areas

generic.Required fields populated and valid: Committed benefit, realised benefit, gap description, plan and closure date
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Realised benefits reconcile to the measurement evidence for each initiative
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Report retained with the reporting period and circulation date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Initiatives without measurement evidence are reported as unproven
generic.Test population: All initiatives with a committed benefit in the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Committed versus realised benefits reported per initiative with gap plans
generic.Exception handling path: Where benefits cannot be measured the initiative is reported as unproven not delivered

steps.title: Collect the committed benefits for each initiative

Flag initiatives approved without a stated benefit

steps.title: Collect the realised benefits from the measurement evidence
sop: Retrieve the post-change measurement for each initiative
Report unmeasured initiatives as unproven rather than delivered
Attach the measurement extract to each figure
Done when realised benefits are collected

Pass when every realised figure traces to an extract

sop: Show committed and realised side by side for each initiative
State the reason for any shortfall

steps.title: Describe remaining gap areas with plans and dates
sop: List the gap areas still open at the end of the period
State the plan and the date to close each one
Name the owner accountable for each gap

verify: Count gaps without a plan or a date

steps.title: Include the customer metric trend for the period
sop: Show the CSAT, NPS and complaint trend across the reporting period

State where the trend cannot be attributed to the programme
Done when the customer trend is included
verify: Compare the trend against the published customer metrics

sop: Build the report with benefits, gaps and the customer trend
Restrict any sensitive detail to the appropriate audience
Publish to the leadership workspace
Done when the report is published
verify: Open the published report and check the three sections are present

steps.title: Circulate the report ahead of the governance meeting
sop: Circulate to senior leadership before the governance meeting
Highlight the decisions being sought
Record the circulation date
